Every work the bridge records that does not serve yet. Nothing here is hidden and nothing is promised: each row carries its recorded id, its measured size, and — on its card — what it awaits. The same records, the same cards, the same laws as the door.

The state of the library: of the 39 books serving, 1 carry witnessed Hebrew titles — their own opening words, claimed from their own records — and 38 read plainly by their recorded ids. The editorial and machine-pointer title registers are built and empty: nothing on this site is guessed.
